paper_name: Physics-informed neural network for lithium-ion battery degradation stable modeling and prognosis

reproduction_mode.reason: The original raw experimental datasets, exact train/validation/test battery identities for the 10-cell synthetic setting, exact learning rate, epochs, learning-rate schedule, early stopping, and complete PDE equation implementation details are not fully available from the supplied materials. Therefore the plan reproduces the reported input-output structure, engineered feature space, PINN family, and executable training/evaluation pipeline using explicit synthetic-data and training assumptions.
what_is_reproduced: cell-level train/validation/test split at 6/2/2 using exactly 10 cells
test RMSE, test R2, and SOH true-versus-predicted plot generation
what_is_not_reproduced: raw voltage/current/time feature extraction unless explicitly implemented

task.target_formula: SOH = current available capacity / initial capacity

model.primary_model_name: Physics-informed neural network for battery SOH estimation

required_signals.signal: charging voltage time series near the end of charge
required_signals.details: Voltage data from each cycle in the range [V_end - 0.2 V, V_end], where V_end is the charge cut-off voltage, are needed to extract statistical voltage-curve features.

required_signals.signal: charging current time series during constant-voltage charging near full charge
required_signals.details: Current data from each cycle with current between 0.5 A and 0.1 A during constant-voltage charging are needed to extract statistical current-curve features.
Cycle/time is used together with the extracted features as input to the PINN and to model degradation dynamics.
The supervised target is battery SOH for each cycle/sample. SOH is defined as the ratio of current available capacity to initial capacity.

required_signals.signal: initial capacity and current available capacity or equivalent capacity measurements
required_signals.details: Required to compute SOH labels, since SOH is the ratio of current available capacity to initial capacity.

required_experiment_types.details: Data should consist of repeated charge/discharge cycles across battery life so that per-cycle degradation trajectory and SOH can be learned.

required_experiment_types.type: charging protocol that reaches full charge
required_experiment_types.details: The feature extraction method assumes the battery is fully charged so that the selected voltage and current ranges before full charge exist.

required_experiment_types.type: CC-CV or equivalent charging containing constant-current and constant-voltage portions
required_experiment_types.details: The method was designed around datasets that mostly contain CC-CV charging, and current features are selected from the constant-voltage charging stage.

required_experiment_types.type: training/test data from multiple cells or batteries
required_experiment_types.details: The model is trained and evaluated by splitting batteries into training, validation, and test sets; small-sample variants can train on as few as one battery but still test on multiple batteries.

assumptions.item: Original raw experimental data are not used in this executable reproduction.
assumptions.filled_assumption: Generate a feature-level synthetic dataset with 10 cells and per-cycle SOH trajectories.

assumptions.item: Exact train/validation/test battery IDs for a 10-cell setting are not paper-reported.
assumptions.filled_assumption: Use deterministic cell split: cell_001-cell_006 train, cell_007-cell_008 validation, cell_009-cell_010 test.

assumptions.item: The paper reports approximately 6:2:2 split by battery, but not for exactly 10 synthetic cells.
assumptions.filled_assumption: Use exactly 6/2/2 cells by cell-level split with no overlap.
assumptions.impact: conforms to user hard constraint but is not original benchmark

assumptions.item: Learning rate is not present in supplied paper/supplementary excerpts.
Epoch count is not present in supplied paper/supplementary excerpts.
assumptions.filled_assumption: Train for at most 300 epochs with early stopping.

assumptions.item: Early stopping protocol and model-selection criterion are not specified in supplied excerpts.
assumptions.filled_assumption: Select the checkpoint with lowest validation RMSE using patience 40.

assumptions.item: Random seed is not specified in supplied excerpts.
assumptions.filled_assumption: Use seed 42 for dataset generation, split, model initialization, and dataloader shuffling.

assumptions.item: Exact complete PINN architecture is not fully recoverable from supplied excerpts for this synthetic setting.
assumptions.filled_assumption: Implement F(.) as a 17-60-60-32-32-1 fully connected network with LinearSin intermediate activations; implement G(.) as a 4-60-60-1 network.
assumptions.impact: affects model capacity and numerical results

assumptions.item: The paper's exact PDE/degradation equation residual implementation is not fully specified in supplied excerpts.
assumptions.filled_assumption: Use executable residual L_pde = mean((d_soh_pred_d_cycle - G(.))^2).

assumptions.item: Loss weights alpha and beta are dataset-specific in paper/supplementary material and not defined for synthetic mixed_NMC_LFP data.
assumptions.filled_assumption: Use alpha=0.7 and beta=20.0 as an executable default.

assumptions.item: Whether cycle/time is min-max normalized is not fully explicit in supplied materials.
assumptions.filled_assumption: Include cycle_index in the train-fitted MinMaxScaler to [-1, 1] along with other model input features.

assumptions.item: SOH target normalization is not stated as required.
assumptions.filled_assumption: Do not normalize SOH labels; train directly on SOH.

assumptions.item: Synthetic feature correlation strengths are not paper-reported.
assumptions.filled_assumption: Generate primary features with medium-to-high but imperfect correlation with SOH/capacity_loss.
assumptions.impact: synthetic data difficulty differs from original data

assumptions.item: Secondary metadata features are not paper-reported as model inputs.
assumptions.filled_assumption: Generate chemistry/protocol metadata for variability but exclude all secondary features from model_input_features.

assumptions.item: Weight decay is not specified in supplied excerpts.
Gradient clipping is not specified in supplied excerpts.
assumptions.filled_assumption: Use max_norm=5.0 to make synthetic PINN training stable.
